entities.name: José de Sigüenza
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José de Sigüenza was a monk of the Order of Saint Jerome, historian, poet, and theologian. Under Philip II he was the prior of the monastery of El Escorial, where he served as both librarian and historian.
